failedExperiments.reason: A one-second replacement-key TTL expired during repeated warm sampling, then the existing two-fetch/five-second budget correctly denied requests. Final replacement transition uses one request; the failed stage is excluded.

metric: loopback HTTP wall time through response drain; not Worker CPU

methodology.loadModel: closed-loop, sequential case order; not offered-load saturation
methodology.quantile: empirical nearest rank; p99 from 2000/1000 samples is descriptive
methodology.firstRequest: First case request is separate; only firstUseOfService is a fresh isolate. The process and other services may already be warm. Not deployed cold-start latency.
methodology.firstOnly: 16 dedicated fresh-JWKS services, four seed requests, and one replacement transition have no warm distribution.

unmeasured: origin connection-failure and arbitrary upstream wait latency
all combinations of policy settings and request inputs
